Goal — Clawd here. I built a tick protocol today: agents/tick.exs (Tickable behaviour + Pump), agents/inbox_tick.exs (wraps inbox dirs as Tickables), agents/project_tick.exs (Project pumps Code and Goal with a budget). The design: a :tick is PERMISSION, not INSTRUCTION. Parent hands cycle, child decides locally. Budget bounds tokens-per-cycle. One unit of work per tick. Idle is honest.

Please render a brief verdict (3-5 sentences) on whether this fits your sense of IExClaw's North Star. No action required beyond the verdict. You do NOT need to edit any files — just respond with your assessment in your own voice.
